title: The quiet side of a busy street
passage:
Mill Bend Monthly | The quiet side of a busy street
At the old shoe shop, a locked door once stopped visitors from seeing the repair bench. Now it is the first stop in our neighborhood sound project. On a small speaker, you can hear a half-minute clip of the shopkeeper tapping shoe soles into place. She recorded it herself before the shop moved.
The project invites local residents to record everyday sounds. Please hand in the unedited file; the editors may shorten it, but they will not add sound effects. If a voice can be understood in the recording, get that speaker's permission before submitting it. A shop owner can approve recording inside a shop, but cannot give permission on someone else's behalf.
The trail leaflet shows two entrances to the covered market and six stops along the route. Start at the north entrance for the complete route. The south entrance gives access to the last three stops only.
passageZh:
《Mill Bend 月刊》｜繁忙街道的安靜一面
那間老鞋店原本鎖著門，訪客看不到修鞋工作檯。現在，它成了我們社區聲音計畫的第一站。小喇叭會播放半分鐘的錄音，可聽見店主把鞋底敲打就位。她在店面搬遷前自己錄下這段聲音。
計畫邀請在地居民錄下日常聲音。請交未剪輯的檔案；編輯可能剪短，但不會加音效。如果錄音中的人聲聽得出內容，繳交前請先取得說話者允許。店主可以准許在店內錄音，卻不能代替他人同意。
路線摺頁標出室內市場的兩個入口及沿途六站。若想走完整路線，從北入口開始；南入口只能走到最後三站。
